content.json:
# D365 F&O · Batch Operations & Incident Explorer — Hierarchy Edition

Select a **Custom incident date and time** (such as 1:00–2:00 PM Eastern), then expand the **JOB → TASK → RUN** rows below. It includes task executions whose intervals overlap the window, even when they started earlier. Start/finish columns are in **America/New_York** (ET, respecting DST).

**Interpretation:** Job and task nodes summarize **observed telemetry**, not authoritative current F&O batch status. "Finish not observed" is a diagnostic clue, not proof that a task is still executing. Parent **JOB** represents a batch job ID across all selected executions; without verified occurrence IDs, repeated parent job runs are **not** separated into distinct run nodes.

For discovering competing work, leave the optional Job ID filter **blank**. A job cannot be discovered if its telemetry was discarded before ingestion. The tree requires task events carrying `activityId`; see the schema-check panels below.

items.name: text - D365 F&O · Batch Operations & Incident Explorer

parameters.name: TimeRange
parameters.label: Incident date & time (choose Custom for 1–2 PM)

parameters.name: JobIdFilter
parameters.label: Optional batch job ID (leave blank to investigate all jobs)

content.json:
## 1 · Parent job → task → execution

Expand a **JOB** to see each D365 batch **TASK**, then expand a task to see its individual **RUN** executions. Rows show observed failure signals, missing finish events, execution start/end times, and task duration. **JOB** and **TASK** aggregate across task executions found in the incident window; they are not the official batch execution status.

content.query:
// F&O built-in batch task telemetry. Application Insights Logs (customEvents).
let incidentStart = {TimeRange:start};
let incidentEnd = {TimeRange:end};
let backDays = min_of(7, max_of(1, toint('{TaskLookbackDays}')));
let filterId = trim(' ', '{JobIdFilter}');
let raw = materialize(
    customEvents
    | where timestamp between ((incidentStart - backDays * 1d) .. min_of(now(), incidentEnd + backDays * 1d))
    | where name in ('BatchTaskStart','BatchTaskFinished','BatchTaskFailure')
    | extend d = customDimensions
    | extend ActivityId = tostring(d['activityId']),
             BatchJobId = tostring(d['BatchJobId']),
             BatchTaskId = iif(isnotempty(tostring(d['BatchJobTaskId'])), tostring(d['BatchJobTaskId']), tostring(d['BatchTaskId'])),
             ClassName = tostring(d['ClassName']),
             Caption = tostring(d['BatchJobCaption']),
             RoleInstance = tostring(cloud_RoleInstance)
    | where isempty(filterId) or BatchJobId == filterId
    | where isnotempty(ActivityId) // avoid false joins across recurring executions
);
let spans = materialize(
    raw
    | summarize StartTime = minif(timestamp, name == 'BatchTaskStart'),
                EndTime = maxif(timestamp, name == 'BatchTaskFinished'),
                FailureTime = maxif(timestamp, name == 'BatchTaskFailure'),
                StartSignals = countif(name == 'BatchTaskStart'),
                FinishSignals = countif(name == 'BatchTaskFinished'),
                Failures = countif(name == 'BatchTaskFailure'),
                BatchJobId = take_any(BatchJobId),
                BatchTaskId = take_any(BatchTaskId),
                ClassName = take_any(ClassName),
                Caption = take_any(Caption),
                RoleInstance = take_any(RoleInstance)
        by ActivityId
    | extend EffectiveStart = coalesce(StartTime, FailureTime, EndTime),
             EffectiveEnd = coalesce(EndTime, FailureTime, incidentEnd)
    | where isnotnull(EffectiveStart) and EffectiveStart < incidentEnd and EffectiveEnd >= incidentStart
    | extend Minutes = iff(isnotnull(StartTime) and isnotnull(EndTime), round((EndTime-StartTime)/1m, 2), real(null)),
             State = case(Failures > 0, 'Failure signal observed', FinishSignals > 0, 'Finished', StartSignals > 0, 'No finish observed', 'Incomplete telemetry')
);
// Three-level tree: a logical job -> each BatchTaskId -> correlated task executions.
// Task ActivityId is the execution correlation key in Microsoft's FastTrack sample.
 // The job node is a logical batch job (not a verified occurrence/run).
let visibleSpans = materialize(
    spans
    | extend GroupJobId = iff(isempty(BatchJobId), '(job ID missing)', BatchJobId),
             TaskKey = iff(isempty(BatchTaskId), strcat('(task ID missing) ', ActivityId), BatchTaskId)
    | extend JobNodeId = strcat('JOB|', GroupJobId),
             TaskNodeId = strcat('TASK|', GroupJobId, '|', TaskKey),
             ExecutionNodeId = strcat('EXEC|', GroupJobId, '|', TaskKey, '|', ActivityId)
);
let jobNodes =
    visibleSpans
    | summarize TaskExecutions=count(),
                FailureSignals=sum(Failures),
                MissingFinishes=countif(StartSignals > 0 and FinishSignals == 0),
                FirstStarted=min(EffectiveStart),
                LastFinished=max(EndTime),
                JobCaption=take_any(Caption)
        by GroupJobId, JobNodeId
    | extend Observation=case(FailureSignals > 0, 'Task failure event(s)',
                              MissingFinishes > 0, 'Task finish not observed',
                              'All observed task executions have finishes')
    | project Id=JobNodeId, ParentId='',
              Name=strcat('JOB ', GroupJobId, iff(isempty(JobCaption),'',strcat(' · ', JobCaption))),
              Level='1 · Job', Observation,
              TaskExecutions=tolong(TaskExecutions), FailureSignals=tolong(FailureSignals),
              MissingFinishes=tolong(MissingFinishes),
              StartedEastern=datetime_utc_to_local(FirstStarted,'America/New_York'),
              FinishedEastern=datetime_utc_to_local(LastFinished,'America/New_York'),
              DurationMinutes=real(null),
              BatchJobId=GroupJobId, BatchTaskId='', ClassName='', ActivityId='';
let taskNodes =
    visibleSpans
    | summarize TaskExecutions=count(),
                FailureSignals=sum(Failures),
                MissingFinishes=countif(StartSignals > 0 and FinishSignals == 0),
                FirstStarted=min(EffectiveStart),
                LastFinished=max(EndTime),
                AnyClassName=take_any(ClassName)
        by GroupJobId, TaskKey, TaskNodeId, JobNodeId
    | extend Observation=case(FailureSignals > 0, 'Task failure event(s)',
                              MissingFinishes > 0, 'Task finish not observed',
                              'All observed executions have finishes')
    | project Id=TaskNodeId, ParentId=JobNodeId,
              Name=strcat('TASK ', TaskKey, iff(isempty(AnyClassName),'',strcat(' · ', AnyClassName))),
              Level='2 · Task', Observation,
              TaskExecutions=tolong(TaskExecutions), FailureSignals=tolong(FailureSignals),
              MissingFinishes=tolong(MissingFinishes),
              StartedEastern=datetime_utc_to_local(FirstStarted,'America/New_York'),
              FinishedEastern=datetime_utc_to_local(LastFinished,'America/New_York'),
              DurationMinutes=real(null),
              BatchJobId=GroupJobId, BatchTaskId=TaskKey, ClassName=AnyClassName, ActivityId='';
let executionNodes =
    visibleSpans
    | project Id=ExecutionNodeId, ParentId=TaskNodeId,
              Name=strcat('RUN ',format_datetime(datetime_utc_to_local(EffectiveStart,'America/New_York'),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'),
                          ' ET · ', substring(ActivityId,0,12)),
              Level='3 · Execution', Observation=State,
              TaskExecutions=tolong(1), FailureSignals=tolong(Failures),
              MissingFinishes=tolong(iff(StartSignals>0 and FinishSignals==0, 1, 0)),
              StartedEastern=datetime_utc_to_local(StartTime,'America/New_York'),
              FinishedEastern=datetime_utc_to_local(EndTime,'America/New_York'),
              DurationMinutes=Minutes,
              BatchJobId=GroupJobId, BatchTaskId=TaskKey, ClassName, ActivityId;
union jobNodes, taskNodes, executionNodes
| extend SortLevel=case(Level startswith '1',0,Level startswith '2',1,2)
| sort by BatchJobId asc, SortLevel asc, StartedEastern asc
| project-away SortLevel
content.title: Batch jobs → tasks → executions (expand the job and task rows)

let incidentStart={TimeRange:start};
let incidentEnd={TimeRange:end};
let filterId=trim(' ','{JobIdFilter}');
customEvents
| where timestamp between (incidentStart .. incidentEnd)
| where name == 'BatchTaskFailure'
| extend d=customDimensions
| extend BatchJobId=tostring(d['BatchJobId'])
| where isempty(filterId) or BatchJobId==filterId
| extend EventEastern=datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp,'America/New_York')
| project EventEastern, BatchJobId, Caption=tostring(d['BatchJobCaption']), ClassName=tostring(d['ClassName']), BatchTaskId=tostring(d['BatchTaskId']), EventMessage=tostring(d['EventMessage']), ExceptionType=tostring(d['ExceptionType']), ExceptionMessage=tostring(d['ExceptionMessage']), ActivityId=tostring(d['activityId']), RoleInstance=cloud_RoleInstance, CallStack=tostring(d['CallStack'])
| order by EventEastern desc

## 3 · Duration and possible missing-completion diagnostics

A missing finish may reflect a stuck task, lost telemetry, or a task that completed after the chosen window. Validate status in **F&O batch history** before taking action.

                BatchJobId = take_any(BatchJobId),
                BatchTaskId = take_any(BatchTaskId),

                Caption = take_any(Caption),
                RoleInstance = take_any(RoleInstance)
        by ActivityId
    | extend EffectiveStart = coalesce(StartTime, FailureTime, EndTime),

             State = case(Failures > 0, 'Failure signal observed', FinishSignals > 0, 'Finished', StartSignals > 0, 'No finish observed', 'Incomplete telemetry')
);
let threshold=toint('{LongRunningMinutes}');
spans
| where StartSignals>0 and FinishSignals==0 and isnotnull(StartTime)
| extend ObservedMinutes=round((min_of(now(),incidentEnd)-StartTime)/1m,1)

| extend StartEastern=datetime_utc_to_local(StartTime,'America/New_York')

content.json:
## 4 · Verify occurrence telemetry and schema

Whole-job occurrence telemetry requires a newer supported F&O build. This exploratory panel lists events containing `BatchJobOccurrence` without guessing their exact names or correlation keys. Use the schema inventory to validate event names, then adapt full-run correlation to your environment.

items.name: text - 5 · Verify occurrence telemetry and schema

content.query:
let incidentStart={TimeRange:start};
let incidentEnd={TimeRange:end};
let filterId=trim(' ','{JobIdFilter}');
customEvents
| where timestamp between ((incidentStart-2d)..incidentEnd)
| where name contains 'BatchJobOccurrence' // discover event names without assuming exact strings
| extend d=customDimensions
| extend BatchJobId=tostring(d['BatchJobId'])
| where isempty(filterId) or BatchJobId==filterId
| extend EventEastern=datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp,'America/New_York')
| project EventEastern, EventName=name, BatchJobId, BatchJobCaption=tostring(d['BatchJobCaption']), ActivityId=tostring(d['activityId']), OtherDimensions=d
| order by EventEastern desc
| take 250
content.title: Batch job occurrence events (raw, last 250)
